title: Booking Hotel & Airport Transfers for Foreign Delegations
description: Foundational sales English module covering booking hotel & airport transfers for foreign delegations.
learning_objectives: Master professional Future with going to & Present Continuous in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in booking hotel & airport transfers for foreign delegations
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: Could you please _____ the revised quotation for twenty 8x8 chassis to the Egyptian ministry as soon as possible?

explanations.correct: Polite modal request 'Could you please...' is followed by bare infinitive 'send' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'to send' is incorrect; modal 'could' does not take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_C: 3rd person singular 'sends' cannot follow modal auxiliary 'could'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Mohl byste prosím poslat...'. After 'Could you please', use the bare verb 'send' without 'to'.
